whatIsAI.title: AI Sachmuch Kya Hai?
whatIsAI.definition: Artificial Intelligence koi jaadu ya soochne wala praani nahi hai. Yeh ek powerful tool hai jo bade data mein patterns dhundta hai.
whatIsAI.analogyText: AI ko sikhana ek bachche ko 'kutta' kya hai sikhane jaise hai. Tum usse biology ki kitaab nahi dete. Tum usse hazaron kutto ki tasweerein dikhate ho jab tak uska dimagh khud-ba-khud pattern ko samajh na le!
whatIsAI.point1: AI examples se seekhta hai, pehle se likhe rules se nahi
whatIsAI.point2: Yeh aisse patterns dhundta hai jo manushya chhod sakte hain
whatIsAI.point3: Recommendations, Voice Assistants Aur Maps Mein Roz Ka Upyog

familyTree.title: AI Parivaar Vriksh
familyTree.subtitle: Artificial Intelligence sirf ek technology nahi hai. Yeh concepts ki ek nested hierarchy hai. Rings par hover karo ya neeche diye gaye cards par click karo taki dekha ja sake ke ye ek dusre mein kaise fit hote hain.
familyTree.hint: Nested system mein iska position highlight karne ke liye card par click karo

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
ai.description: Sabse wasi chhatri. Koi bhi technology jo machines ko human-like reasoning, matching, ya puzzle-solving ki nakal karne deti hai.

ml.title: Machine Learning (ML)
ml.description: AI ka ek subset jahan computer systems historical examples se directly rules seekhte hain, hand-written code rules ko bypass karke.

dl.title: Deep Learning (DL)
dl.description: ML ki gahari tah jo stacked artificial neural networks istemal karke human voice ya faces jaise complex structures mein automatically mastery obtain karte hain.

genai.title: Generative AI (GenAI)
genai.description: Sabse naya inner-core. AI systems jo huge content maps par training paate hain bilkul nayi images, writing, ya audio tracks create karne ke liye.

supervised.title: Supervised Learning
supervised.description: Tum machine ko labeled pictures dete ho (like 'dog' ya 'cat') jab tak woh seekh jata hai ke kaun se visual clues kaun se label se match karte hain.

unsupervised.title: Unsupervised Learning
unsupervised.description: Machine unlabeled data ko khud se groups mein divide karta hai, hidden patterns ya similarities dhundta hai jo tum miss kar sakte ho.

reinforcement.title: Reinforcement Learning
reinforcement.description: Machine trial-and-error loop mein kaam karta hai, sahi moves ke liye points karta hai (jaise dog ko treats deke sikhane jaise).

deeperDetails.aiConcepts: Rule-based expert systems, static decision trees, aur custom pattern matchers. AI ko hamesha khud se seekhne ki zaroorat nahi; woh hand-written, smart logical pathways follow kar sakta hai.
deeperDetails.aiExamples: Chess computers (IBM Deep Blue), automated route planning, logic solver programs.
deeperDetails.aiTip: Basic AI ko ek bada, pehle se draw kiya gaya map samjho. Computer map par roads find karne mein super fast hai, lekin khud ek bhi nayi road nahi bana sakta.
deeperDetails.mlConcepts: Feature vectors, weights, linear regression, aur classifiers. ML systems ko zyada training files parse karte waqt algorithms ko dynamically optimize karne deta hai.
deeperDetails.mlExamples: Email spam detection, credit scoring, product recommendation engines.
deeperDetails.mlTip: ML ek dog ko good behavior ke liye treats dene jaise hai. Algorithm ko correct predictions ke liye 'points' milte hain jab tak woh skill mein master na ho jaye.
deeperDetails.dlConcepts: Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) deep hidden layers ke sath. Activations forward propagate hote hain, errors back bheje jate hain neural weights adjust karne ke liye.
deeperDetails.dlExamples: Face recognition (Apple FaceID), real-time speech translation, autonomous vehicle vision.
deeperDetails.dlTip: Deep Learning virtual filters ki ek hierarchy istemal karta hai. Early layers basic lines aur edges pakdte hain, middle layers unhe shapes mein group karte hain, final layers complete object dekhte hain.
deeperDetails.genaiConcepts: Generative models, Large Language Models (LLMs), attention mechanisms, aur Transformers. Woh world content ko bilkul nayi creations synthesize karne ke liye map karte hain.
deeperDetails.genaiExamples: Gemini, ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALL-E, GitHub Copilot.
deeperDetails.genaiTip: GenAI sirf copy-paste nahi karta! Woh human creation ke deep grammatical ya visual 'recipes' seekhta hai taki woh tere instructions se bilkul nayi cheezon ko create kar sake.

familyTree.quickTakeaway: AI ek technology nahi balke nested hierarchy hai: AI (sabse wasi) mein ML hai, jisme DL hai, jo GenAI ko power deta hai. Har level apne se pehle wale par build hota hai aur specialized hota hai.

generativeAI.title: Generative AI Kyaa Hota Hai?
generativeAI.intro: Haal me, AI zyadatar data analyze, sort, ya predict karne ke liye use hota tha. But Generative AI — Artificial Intelligence ki ek nayi branch jo bilkul nayi content, images aur music banati hai — ne creative possibilities khol di hain.
generativeAI.generativeDefinition: Artificial Intelligence ki nayi branch jo existing data se seekhe hue patterns ke base par nayi content banati hai.
generativeAI.quickTakeawayGenAI: Generative AI insaano jaise 'sochti' nahi. Ye ek advanced prediction machine hai.

zeroshot.title: Zero-Shot Prompting
zeroshot.definition: Examples dikhaye bina model se kuch karne ko kaho.

rag.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
rag.definition: Document search ko text generation ke sath combine karke hallucinations ko rokna.
